title: 28827 - 28827/U0155/049493
models: Tüm VAG Grubu Modeller (Audi, VW, Seat, Skoda, Porsche)
engines: Tüm VAG Benzinli (TSI/TFSI) ve Dizel (TDI) Motorlar
commonCauses: Connector(s)/Kablo Tesisatı ve Soketleri from/to Instrument Cluster faulty
stepByStepSolution: Kontrol edin:  Connector(s)/Kablo Tesisatı ve Soketleri from/to Instrument Cluster

Kontrol edin:  Databus Communication
See Measuring Value Blocks (MVB)
technicalNotes:
When found in Engine Control Module without any obvious cause (i.e. Measuring Value Blocks show plausible Values)
Kontrol edin:  Oil Level and Temperature Sensör Okuma Değerleri Installation Information in Instrument Cluster Adaptasyon / Kalibrasyon Yapın:  Channel 039.
